title: Intensity setting is not saved correctly for OFF events
description: When creating a lighting event that is set to 'Off', the intensity level is not saved as configured by the user. Instead, it defaults to 100%.
steps: 4. Enter 'Program E' in the 'Name Your Program' field and tap 'Next'.
5. Select 'EVERY DAY OF THE WEEK' and tap 'Next'.
7. Select 'Zone' and tap the dropdown arrow.
8. Select 'Zuiioh Zone 1' from the list and tap 'Next'.
13. Select 'Zone' and tap the dropdown arrow.
14. Select 'Zuiioh Zone 1' from the list and tap 'Next'.
15. Select the 'Off' toggle for the intensity.
18. Tap the menu icon (three dots) for 'Program E' on the schedule list.
19. Tap the edit icon for the 'When: Sunset Zone: Zuiioh Event: Off' event.
20. Observe the intensity setting on the 'When do you want the lighting event to occur?' screen; it should reflect the 'Off' state.
23. Observe the intensity setting on the 'Zuiioh' screen; it displays '55%' instead of 'Off'.
actual: When creating an 'Off' event, after saving and reopening the event, the intensity is displayed as 55% (or another value other than 'Off' as intended by the user).
expected: When creating an 'Off' event, the intensity setting should be saved as 'Off' and displayed as 'Off' when the event is revisited.
